brief: A 16-second widescreen ad for Petal & Stem, a small neighbourhood flower shop: the florist opens the shop at dawn and arranges a bouquet, then hands it to a smiling customer at the door; warm, natural light; end on the shop front.

llm.name: keyref2-piece-v1
llm.purpose: the whole piece as one timed prose prompt, in parts

beats.text: 0–4 seconds: In a medium-wide exterior shot at dawn, the florist unlocks and opens the shop’s front door from outside, then steps inside. Follow gently toward the doorway in warm, natural light, keeping the shop sign above the frame.

4–9 seconds: Cut naturally inside to a close view of the florist’s hands gathering loose cream and peach flower stems with green foliage into one bouquet, then wrapping it in kraft paper on the worktable. Warm, natural dawn light falls across the hands; these loose stems become the single wrapped bouquet used throughout the remaining shots.

9–13 seconds: Cut to a medium two-shot at the open front door as the florist hands that same wrapped bouquet to the smiling customer. Hold the exchange clearly until the customer has the bouquet securely in both hands, with warm, natural light across their faces and the shop sign out of frame.

13–16 seconds: Cut wider outside and ease back to reveal the whole neighbourhood shop front, with the florist in the doorway and the smiling customer holding the same bouquet beside it. Settle on the facade in warm, natural dawn light, making the sign reading “Petal & Stem” clearly legible above the door.

rules: Prompt first: the whole piece is written as one prose prompt with timestamps; it is cut into chunks only when it is longer than one generation (ltx-2.5 60 s, minimax-h3 30 s) or --clips forces it, at beat boundaries.
Each chunk's prompt = the shared lines (look, subject, the descriptions of the elements in it, exact words, the "no"s) + its beats retimed from 0.

Asset bank, for seeding only: the first appearance of something that must look specific (a picture the user gave; an exact sign or label: painted once on qwen-image-2.1, yes/no-checked, reused). Nothing else is painted.

Every other reference comes from earlier frames: for chunk k>1, the frames of earlier chunks at the seconds the state says an entity was seen are searched; the clearest is vision-confirmed and attached as @name.
Chunk k>1 also gets @previous: the last frame of chunk k-1, or the latest earlier frame that passes the state checks.
Model: ltx-2.5 when no chunk carries a reference; minimax-h3 otherwise. Audio off unless the brief asks for sound.

After each chunk: yes/no questions at each beat's timestamp (is each expected entity there?) and over the whole chunk (exact text everywhere, one product, the same people, the ending); one regeneration with the failure named if a required check fails, within the run's budget.
ffmpeg joins only when there is more than one chunk.
